title: Implement immutable Hunt workspace validation and projection runtime
goal: Implement a Go standard-library-only immutable projection of caller-owned Hunt workspace context with tenant/access/provenance checks and explicit completeness/limitation diagnostics.
outputs: tenant-safe typed references to Query/Search Job/Hypothesis/Case/Incident
invariants: no canonical Hunt object or final Hunt state machine is invented
the bounded runtime validates and projects caller-owned Hunt workspace state; it does not persist or mutate a Hunt
OPEN-013 remains unresolved and every class-2 Hunt/Case/Hypothesis/Query mutation is excluded
Query and Search Job remain owned by Shared Capabilities
Hypothesis and Case remain owned by their canonical Investigate capabilities
tenant and environment scope are mandatory and no wildcard/default tenant fallback is allowed
CAP-INV-003, CAP-INV-006, CAP-INV-008 and CAP-INV-103 runtimes are not assumed to exist
no provider, storage engine, final query dialect, collaboration backend, retention policy or final Hunt UI is selected
product runtime path mutation remains deferred until E10-INV-005A-BOUNDARY registers unique ownership
security_properties: all object references are tenant-scoped and caller-provided access decisions fail closed
denied or cross-tenant Query/Search Job/Hypothesis/Case/Incident references cannot appear in a returned projection
workspace projection is immutable and deep-copy isolated from caller input
no query execution, Case promotion, Hypothesis creation/status mutation or contributor mutation occurs
question/scope/time/owner/contributor provenance and correlation remain explicit
partial or stale inputs are represented as limitations rather than synthesized facts
acceptance_tests: caller/source input cannot be mutated or aliased by the projection
cross-tenant or denied references fail closed
missing required draft activation context yields diagnostics without inventing transitions
runtime executes no query and performs no class-2 mutation
security-critical runtime coverage target is at least 90 percent

performance_budget.rationale: workspace projection is a pure local transformation independent of persistence/providers
metrics: bounded local workspace-projection p95 target declared by A-BOUNDARY
no production Hunt workflow SLO claim

migration.rationale: bounded Hunt core is in-process, persistence-neutral and does not create a canonical Hunt object

rollback.strategy: revert the current bounded task and keep downstream Hunt tasks blocked
verification: no ledger claim is created before bounded closure
no external canonical object is mutated

definition_of_done: caller/source input cannot be mutated or aliased by the projection
cross-tenant or denied references fail closed
missing required draft activation context yields diagnostics without inventing transitions
